 Partly cloudy skies expected in four provinces, light snowfall likely 
 Nepal News 
 November 18, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 File photo 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: The influence of westerly winds has brought cloudy conditions to the Himalayan and hilly regions of Koshi, Bagmati and Gandaki Provinces while the hilly areas of Lumbini Province have experienced partly cloudy weather.
 Some places in the Terai are covered in haze at present while the weather remains generally clear in the rest of the country, according to the Nepal Meteorological Department.
 The Department has forecast partly cloudy conditions in the Himalayan and hilly regions of Koshi, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini provinces this afternoon, while other areas are expected to experience clear weather.
 Light rain and snowfall are also likely at one or two places in the Himalayan regions of Koshi and Gandaki provinces, predicted the weather service.
 Tonight, partly cloudy conditions are expected in Koshi, Madhesh and Lumbini Provinces, as well as in the Himalayan and hilly regions of Bagmati and Gandaki Provinces.
 The weather will remain mainly clear in the remaining areas, the Department said.
 It has also forecast fog and mist in the Terai, valleys and river basins during the early morning hours.
